design.nomination: Same active two-band repeat nomination as the retained static mouth study.
design.motion: Compare signed, central eye-aligned mouth picture differences on consecutive native pairs. Search one common small translation between sequences. Reject activity or geometry gaps, matching native mouth pixels, and closely matching wide pictures.
design.point: From four fixed distances, maximize correct development pairs with zero flagged development controls, at least one correct pair, and strict exceedance. Use the most conservative tied point. Use the largest predeclared point if none qualify.
design.roles: Rebuild the previous four development and eight retained source-disjoint qualified actors. Independently acquire the already archived source bytes from two disjoint recent paired picture studies and prepare the first exact eligible 2.52 s extent. Keep every planned source and report infeasible inputs.
design.advance: In both carriers on transfer only, add six correct locations over the static comparison across four new actors, keep its correct locations, add at most one ordinary alert and none on synchronized or whole-track controls, and assess at least 75% of cases. A location must overlap both authored witness ranges by at least half. No AI confidence weight.
